summary: Iteration 2 backend + frontend tested end-to-end. All 17 pytest tests pass (mode toggles, sandbox safety rail, LLM status, swarm CRUD, real-LLM path via Emergent key, drivers not_armed responses, analytics history persisted, WS payload includes swarm+mode). Playwright walk-through of the UI confirmed: mode badge (sandbox default), open-swarm, graduated panel opens on badge click, arm-* buttons disabled in sandbox / enabled in graduated, spawn agent appears in leaderboard, provider dropdown lists OpenAI/Claude/Gemini, stop-all empties leaderboard, dropdashin panel exposes Configure Drivers -> GraduatedPanel, ws:live indicator present. No blocking issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: SwarmPanel provider <select> is disabled when realLlm=false — user cannot preselect provider before arming llm_real. Consider allowing selection even when disabled or auto-enabling once mode+driver are ready. Not blocking.

agents.py: `agent.total_earnings += snap['earnings'] * 0.02` uses the network's cumulative earnings, so per-tick attribution grows super-linearly. Fine for a live leaderboard demo but not a real attribution model.
server.py `_snapshot_worker` counts documents on every 5s tick then does an extra find+delete — for a 1500-cap ring buffer, a capped collection or `find_one_and_delete` per insert would be cheaper.

pytest.ini forces `-n 2 --dist loadscope`: swarm tests share global backend state and interfere across workers (test_sandbox_disarms_all wipes agents used by parallel class). We had to run with `-n 0`. Consider marking swarm-mutating tests with @pytest.mark.serial or scoping the swarm reset fixture more tightly.
seed_data_creation: none — tests spawn/cleanup TEST_ prefixed agents; history is auto-generated by the snapshot worker.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend tests with `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration2.py -n 0` (xdist parallel breaks swarm cross-test isolation). Real-LLM test spawns a graduated+llm_real agent and polls up to ~20s for last_source=='real'; EMERGENT_LLM_KEY must remain set in /app/backend/.env. Frontend already switched to sandbox at end of run.
